fact_text: Pakistan Tobacco declared a dividend of Rs 10 per share, one of the first value-stock dividends of the season.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Pakistan Tobacco's top line and earnings per share grew strongly, the analyst said, even as the price of Gold Leaf rose sharply.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: The government levies very heavy taxes on tobacco, a structural burden the analyst highlighted for Pakistan Tobacco.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Lucky Core Industries, formerly ICI Pakistan, declared a dividend of Rs 33 per share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Lucky Core Industries has built a larger portfolio through pharmaceutical and chemical acquisitions, and its soda ash business is still growing, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Crescent Steel paid a good dividend and also runs a spiral pipe business, a segment tied to gas pipeline demand.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Spiral pipe demand in Pakistan comes largely from gas pipeline projects of Sui Northern and Sui Southern.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: The analyst has tracked spinning-industry earnings for about 20 years and found them volatile, moving up and down with industry conditions.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Under Sui Northern's fixed-return formula set from 2002, a 17.5% figure was passed through, and gross margin above it went to the government as a surcharge or levy.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Since the 2020-21 period, the analyst said, gas price increases pass through to Sui Northern's gross margin instead of going to the government.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Sui Northern reported a profit for the first quarter of the previous fiscal year, which the analyst linked to higher gas prices passing through to gross margin.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Sui Southern's share price is low, and the analyst attributed this to its results being at a disadvantage.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Dividends from value stocks, including multinational companies' stocks, have started to be paid this season, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: The analyst noted several sessions of selling before the video, which he said shows up in the FIPI and LIPI numbers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: MCB Bank trades at about 1.13 times price-to-book, above one times, though the analyst still considers it a value stock.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: The analyst treats a price-to-book multiple below one as a valuation opportunity, for example at Bank Al Habib.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Fertiliser offtake figures for July showed some growth, which the analyst linked to the rice sowing season as an application period.

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer pays higher gas prices than Fauji Fertilizer, and the analyst pointed to this gap as a cost disadvantage for Engro.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer's second-quarter result was very strong against Engro Fertilizer's, a result the analyst tied to the gas price gap.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer Bin Qasim grew its DAP business in the July offtake, and the analyst described it as a leading local DAP producer.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer's urea numbers fell during maintenance at its new plant, while its DAP numbers grew, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Dividend Season for Value Stocks: Market Analysis & Financial Results | PSX Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-09)
